name: Embercoil Temple
_plan: One room, and the only one in the building with no fire in it. Eight seats set well back from the middle, facing in, and every groove in the floor running to the same place. It is a room built for sitting still in, which is the whole argument of the civilisation that built it, and the player is meant to read that off the furniture rather than be told it. The scene at the middle is deliberately short: the room and the quiet carry it, and the man speaking gets five boxes and no explanation.
